d: Honey-blonde hair is tied into a high, curly ponytail with a side-swept bang over the forehead. Sharp, narrow blue eyes set on a mature, youthful face. A fit, toned build wearing a cropped olive-green short-sleeved shirt, a black tactical chest rig, tan cargo capris, black fingerless gloves, and black lace-up combat boots. A black handgun is holstered at the hip, and a large black sniper rifle is held across the shoulders.
